ValidationRule.description: Checked only when the payment plan or token amount is set or changed, so unrelated saves (unit tagging, booking form link) on older records are not blocked.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISNULL(Token_Amount__c), NOT(ISBLANK(Payment_Plan__c)), OR(ISNEW(), ISCHANGED(Payment_Plan__c), ISCHANGED(Token_Amount__c)) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Token amount is required before adding payment plan
